**QA-21916: PASS.** The report is at `results/2026-11-18/QA-21916-report.md`.

I ran both Wednesday rows from the case's Description table on dev, YouTube only, over Nov 10–16, 2026. Each row's brand loaded as the exact spec name.

| Row | LFM Likes | Native Likes | LFM Comments | Native Comments |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Apple Services / Apple Music | 369 | 387 (+4.9%) | 66 | 67 (+1.5%) |
| Condé Nast / GQ - Japan | 1,741 | 1,775 (+2.0%) | 31 | 31 (0%) |

- **Threshold:** the case gives no numeric limit, so I used the ~10% bound from the native-post-check skill. All four values are inside it.
- **Native counts:** I read the native likes as the "other people" figure plus 1, as the earlier runs did. Reading it literally changes each result by less than 0.2 points.
- **Known bugs:** no open linked bugs. LFMP-32113 (native lower than LFM) did not reproduce, since native was at or above LFM on all four values.
- **Stale note in the case:** its Notes line pairs Wednesday with Apple Services/Wasserman, which conflicts with the Description table. I followed the table and flagged it in the report.
- **Amazon Prime Video:** not needed, since both Wednesday rows had YouTube posts.

I did no skill, REGISTRY or knowledge-base maintenance, as instructed. Two quirks are recorded in the report for harvest: the `.image-card` text locator doesn't match, so click `.image-link` `.first()` and listen for the popup; and the account option is spelled "Condé Nast" with the accent.
